rca_of_the_issue: RCA: In iter-10, me_pay_with_wallet was updated to mark order as 'verified' on wallet payment but only dispatched notify_order_status + send_wallet_receipt_email. It missed send_order_receipt_email (the printable order-paid receipt with OPEN LIVE TRACKER button) — meaning wallet-paid customers got a wallet-debit receipt but no order receipt. Reproduction: pay a priced unpaid order via /api/me/orders/{id}/pay-with-wallet → only wallet receipt arrives. Fix: added asyncio.create_task(send_order_receipt_email(...)) at server.py:4535. Verified by introspecting source of me_pay_with_wallet for both call sites.
